@vspace -0.735
@rule2 cols foot
@obs body: the rules of the frame are printed heavy outside and thin inside; set as in the other tables. The print is slightly skewed (the rules lean about 0.7 pt over the height of the table).
@obs figure: «اكتوبر» is printed with the tā' as a small stroke over the join of kāf and wāw; «المطرّح» with shadda and fatḥa; the Latin of the head of the last two columns is printed «[qu» at the end of its third line (for «[qui»), and its hyphens as raised dots.
@obs body L7, L8: a mark is printed after the 6 of Iunius (L7) and a dot after the 2 of September (L8); not transcribed.
@obs body L11: the 8 of «280» is printed broken.
@obs body L17: a mark is printed over the 5 of Iunius; not transcribed.
@obs body L23: the 2 of «1428» is printed broken.
